children: Ironman seeks TSXV acceptance to reduce the conversion price on $500K of debentures from $0.10 to $0.05 per share and extend maturity from November 22 to November 30, 2026. Approval is pending.
The proposed price is half the current $0.10, increasing potential share issuance per converted dollar; TSXV acceptance remains pending.
The extension is only eight days, so it provides limited additional time before maturity.
Debentures bear 12.0% annual interest, paid monthly
The high coupon is an ongoing cash cost; the release gives no comparison with prior financing costs.
$250K held by company directors or their controlled entity
The related-party portion may draw governance scrutiny; the company says it relies on MI 61-101 exemptions.
This is a financing amendment for outstanding 2022 debentures, rather than a new operating or earnings catalyst. TSXV acceptance and the subsequent company announcement are the next milestones.
Based on the original press release from Ironman International Ltd. distributed by TheNewswire.
